$comment: Named-technique catalog for the Quant Strategy Intelligence Layer. Aliases map to CORE or EXPERIMENTAL modules, or honest NOT_SUPPORTED. Not 1,000 live evaluate() edges. Default evaluateAll() remains the five CORE strategies. Do not set experimental env vars to true to see if it works.
note: Argus organizes 760 named techniques into family modules. Live Quant still evaluates only CORE unless a per-id env flag is true. Walk-forward OOS for checked combos failed; experimental modules stay UNVALIDATED. 1,000 names are not 1,000 edges.
